summary: Verified all 5 iter212m-154 PROD-regression fixes on PREVIEW (https://launch-pad-237.preview.emergentagent.com). 5/5 PASS. Regressions clean (login, dashboard hydrate, SystemStatsPage KPI cards). Tested both desktop 1440x900 and mobile 390x844.

fix1_activation_funnel_cold_cache.detail: After `sudo supervisorctl restart backend && sleep 4`, first call to GET /api/aurem-dev/admin/insights/activation-funnel returned HTTP 200 in 140ms (cold) with full funnel payload (signup_to_github, github_to_project, totals.all_users=44 etc). Second call warm in 122ms HTTP 200. No HTTP 499. Well under 3s requirement.

fix2_hosted_deploy_status_empty.detail: GET /api/aurem-dev/hosted-deploy/status/p_does_not_exist_test returned HTTP 200 with body {ok:true, connected:false, project_found:false, provider:null, connected_at:null, last_deploy:null, last_status:null, last_response:""}. Previously was 404.

fix3_tokens_unlimited_render.detail: test@aurem.dev on PREVIEW returns is_unlimited=true via /auth/me. /tokens page tokens-remaining card text = ' tokens remaining∞ Unlimited' on BOTH desktop 1440 and mobile 390. Infinity symbol + 'Unlimited' word both present. Manual localStorage flag override NOT required.

fix4_toast_responsive_offset.detail: Toast dispatched via window.dispatchEvent('aurem:toast'). Element [data-testid=toaster] / .aurem-toaster rendered. DESKTOP 1440: top=24px right=24px (matches spec). MOBILE 390: top=88px right=12px — offset >=88px requirement met, below the top bar.

fix5_bug_hunt_authed_redirect.detail: AUTHED (aurem_token in localStorage): /bug-hunt -> redirects to /codebase-health, h1='How healthy is your code today?'. ANON (token cleared): /bug-hunt stays on /bug-hunt, renders public marketing h1='Detect security vulnerabilities in your codebase before they ship'.

regression_checks.login_flow: PASS — POST /api/aurem-dev/auth/login returned 200 + JWT (273 char) for test@aurem.dev / AuremTest2026!. /auth/me confirms tier=founder, is_admin=true, is_unlimited=true.
regression_checks.dashboard_hydrate: PASS — /dashboard loaded with project header, Health Scanner, Codebase Graph rails and project banner visible.
regression_checks.system_stats_desktop: PASS — /admin/system-stats rendered on desktop with 8 KPI-like elements and headings 'SYSTEM OBSERVABILITY', 'PARLIAMENT RUNS', 'COUNCIL SUCCESS RATE', 'CIRCUIT BREAKER OPENS · 24H' all visible.
